bug: Counts records instead of physical lines, so line numbers drift after a multi-line quoted field
Opens the file as plain utf-8, so a BOM sticks to the first header name and the required column looks missing
Matches footers with search instead of a whole-field match, so 'GRAND TOTAL' and 'totally_real' rows are dropped
Compares the raw (unstripped) record to the header, so a repeated header with extra spaces becomes a data row
Checks required values before the field count, so a ragged row is reported as missing_required
Computes the missing columns with a set difference, so SchemaError.missing isn't in the required order

edits.find: missing := [c for c in required if c not in header]
